name: Melville Mall
summary: Melville Mall is a community shopping center in the heart of Long Island's Melville commercial district, owned by Federal Realty Investment Trust. The center serves affluent suburban communities with convenient access to quality retailers and maintains a strong 4.4-star rating from over 1,100 customer reviews.
demographics: Melville Mall serves an affluent suburban Long Island demographic, primarily drawing from middle to upper-middle income households in the Melville, Huntington, and surrounding Nassau County areas. The trade area attracts professionals and families with median household incomes significantly above the national average, typically ranging from $100,000 to $150,000+. Primary shoppers include working professionals aged 35-65, families with children, and retirees seeking convenient access to quality retailers and services. The center benefits from its location in a major Long Island employment hub, capturing both residential shoppers and daytime office workers from nearby corporate campuses.
description: Melville Mall, located at 834 Walt Whitman Road in Melville, New York, is a well-established community shopping center owned and operated by Federal Realty Investment Trust, one of the nation's premier retail real estate companies. Situated in the heart of Long Island's thriving commercial corridor, the center serves the affluent communities of Melville, Huntington, and surrounding Nassau County areas with convenient access to quality retailers and services. As part of Federal Realty's distinguished portfolio of high-performing properties, Melville Mall benefits from professional management and a commitment to creating exceptional shopping experiences. The center maintains strong community ties and consistently high customer satisfaction, reflected in its impressive 4.4-star rating from over 1,100 reviews. With convenient operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily and ample parking, Melville Mall continues to serve as a vital retail destination for Long Island residents seeking a curated mix of national retailers and local businesses in a well-maintained, accessible environment.
